```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=data, palette='Set2')

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
